aries.title: Retrograde in Aries
aries.kicker: What each planet revisits when it turns back in Aries

rows.t: The words you fired too fast; say them again, slower.
How you chase what you desire; let attraction come closer on its own.
The fights you started by reflex; choose which ones still matter.
Your faith in bold leaps; check which ones truly helped you grow.
The patience you skipped; rebuild your courage on firmer ground.
Your urge to break free; ask what you are freeing yourself for.
The heroic image you hold of yourself; let it soften into truth.
Where your will turned into force; reclaim power without the push.

aries.bridge: Aries runs forward; retrograde lets it turn and look.
story: In the Greek telling, a golden ram flew to the rescue.
Nephele sent it to save Phrixus and Helle from Ino.
Helle slipped into the sea, ever after the Hellespont.
Phrixus reached Colchis and offered the ram to Zeus.
Its fleece, hung in a guarded grove, was the Golden Fleece.
The ram was raised among the stars, first sign of spring.
aries.close: What you rushed may ask to be begun again.

taurus.title: Retrograde in Taurus
taurus.kicker: What each planet revisits when it turns back in Taurus

rows.t: The opinions you settled long ago; reopen them with fresh curiosity.
What you truly value; release comforts that no longer feel like yours.
Where stubbornness passed for strength; move steadily, but do move.
Your idea of abundance; notice how much enough already holds.
What you hold on to out of fear; keep only what lasts.
The routines you call security; let one small change breathe in.
The dreams you placed in things; find the beauty that needs no owning.
What you possess, and what quietly possesses you; loosen the grip.

taurus.bridge: Taurus builds slowly; retrograde tends the foundations.
story: In the Greek telling, Zeus became a gleaming white bull.
Europa, gathering flowers by the shore, climbed on his back.
He swam out across the sea and carried her to Crete.
Her son Minos would become the island's legendary king.
The bull's image was raised into the night sky.
The Hyades mark its face; the Pleiades ride its shoulder.
taurus.close: What you keep may ask to be chosen again.

gemini.title: Retrograde in Gemini
gemini.kicker: What each planet revisits when it turns back in Gemini

rows.t: The messages left half-read; return to them with full attention.
How you flirt with ideas and people; notice which conversations truly connect.
The arguments you won with cleverness; ask whether they were worth winning.
Everything you wanted to learn at once; pick one thread and follow it.
Your scattered plans; give one idea the structure it deserves.
Your restless mind; let the sudden insight land before you speak.
The stories you tell yourself; separate what you heard from what is true.
Words that carried hidden weight; say what you really mean.

gemini.bridge: Gemini asks questions; retrograde asks them twice.
story: In the Greek telling, Castor and Pollux were Leda's twins.
Castor was mortal; Pollux, a son of Zeus, was immortal.
When Castor fell, Pollux refused to live on without him.
Zeus let them share one fate, between Olympus and Hades.
Set side by side in the sky, they became guides for sailors.
gemini.close: What you said may ask to be heard again.

cancer.title: Retrograde in Cancer
cancer.kicker: What each planet revisits when it turns back in Cancer

rows.t: Old family conversations; listen again for what was really meant.
How you care for others; let yourself be cared for too.
The way you defend your own; protect without closing the door.
What home means to you now; widen the circle you call family.
The walls you built to feel safe; check which still serve you.
Habits inherited at home; keep the warmth, change the pattern.
The nostalgia that colors memory; honor the past without living there.
Deep roots and old loyalties; release what was never yours to carry.

cancer.bridge: Cancer remembers; retrograde helps it remember kindly.
story: In the Greek telling, Hera sent a crab against Heracles.
He was fighting the Hydra in the marshes of Lerna.
The crab pinched his foot, and the hero crushed it.
Hera rewarded its loyalty with a place among the stars.
Its faint stars cradle the Beehive cluster, Praesepe.
cancer.close: What you sheltered may ask to be felt again.

leo.title: Retrograde in Leo
leo.kicker: What each planet revisits when it turns back in Leo

rows.t: How you tell your own story; let other voices enter it.
Romance and play; love for the joy of it, not the applause.
Pride that turned into contest; lead with warmth instead of force.
Your generosity and grand gestures; give where it truly lands.
Your need to be seen; build confidence that holds in the dark.
Your creative signature; let it surprise even you, once more.
The role you perform for approval; find the self beneath the costume.
Where pride guards an old wound; let your heart lead, not your ego.

leo.bridge: Leo shines outward; retrograde turns the light within.
story: In the Greek telling, a lion terrorized the valley of Nemea.
Its golden hide could not be pierced by any weapon.
Heracles cornered it in its cave and strangled it.
He wore its skin ever after as cloak and armor.
Zeus set the lion in the sky, with Regulus at its heart.
leo.close: What you showed may ask to be felt again.

virgo.title: Retrograde in Virgo
virgo.kicker: What each planet revisits when it turns back in Virgo

rows.t: The details you corrected in others; turn that care toward yourself.
How you show love through service; let gratitude flow both ways.
Your daily work; refine the method instead of pushing harder.
Your standards of improvement; leave generous room for good enough.
Duties you took on silently; keep the ones that truly matter.
Rigid routines; invent a better way to do the everyday.
The perfection you keep chasing; trust that imperfect work still counts.
The urge to control every detail; sift, and let the rest go.

virgo.bridge: Virgo sorts the harvest; retrograde sorts it again.
story: In the Greek telling, she is Astraea, maiden of justice.
She lived among humans through the Golden Age.
As people grew cruel, she was the last immortal to leave.
She rose into the sky holding an ear of wheat.
That ear is Spica, the bright star of the harvest.
virgo.close: What you perfected may ask to be loosened.

libra.title: Retrograde in Libra
libra.kicker: What each planet revisits when it turns back in Libra

rows.t: Agreements and promises; reread the terms you accepted to keep peace.
Your partnerships; ask whether the give and take still feels fair.
Conflicts you avoided for harmony; speak up, gently but clearly.
Your ideals of justice; apply them to yourself as well.
Commitments made to others; weigh which ones are balanced and true.
The roles you play in relationships; give each other room to change.
The ideal partner you imagined; see the real person in front of you.
Power hidden in politeness; restore balance where one side holds too much.

libra.bridge: Libra weighs; retrograde lets the scales settle.
story: Early Greek astronomers saw here the Scorpion's claws.
Its brightest stars are still named for the two claws.
The Romans read the figure as a pair of scales.
In antiquity the Sun passed here near the autumn equinox.
The only zodiac figure that is an object, not a creature.
libra.close: What you balanced may ask to be weighed again.

scorpio.title: Retrograde in Scorpio
scorpio.kicker: What each planet revisits when it turns back in Scorpio

rows.t: Secrets you kept and things left unsaid; decide what deserves daylight.
Intimacy and trust; ask who earned your depth, and who did not.
Old resentments and quiet grudges; turn that intensity toward renewal.
What you share with others; let trust grow where it is returned.
Your fear of loss; build closeness on boundaries, not control.
Patterns of jealousy or suspicion; let sudden honesty clear the air.
Fantasies of merging completely; love deeply while staying yourself.
What must end so something can begin; let the old skin go.

scorpio.bridge: Scorpio digs deep; retrograde returns to what is buried.
story: In the Greek telling, Orion boasted he could slay any beast.
Gaia sent a scorpion, and its sting brought the hunter down.
Both were placed in the sky, on opposite sides.
As Scorpius rises in the east, Orion sinks in the west.
At its heart burns red Antares, the rival of Ares.
scorpio.close: What you buried may ask to be faced again.

sagittarius.title: Retrograde in Sagittarius
sagittarius.kicker: What each planet revisits when it turns back in Sagittarius

rows.t: Bold claims you made with certainty; check your facts once more.
Love that lives on distance and dreams; bring it closer to home.
Crusades for your beliefs; aim your arrows with more care.
Your big philosophy of life; see if it still fits your experience.
Promises larger than your reach; shape the vision into real steps.
Inherited beliefs; test which truths you chose and which you borrowed.
Teachers and gurus you idealized; let your own wisdom guide you.
Convictions you hold too tightly; allow your truth to evolve.

sagittarius.bridge: Sagittarius aims far; retrograde checks the aim.
story: The Archer, often drawn as a centaur, aims at Scorpius.
In one Greek telling he is Crotus, raised among the Muses.
Said to have invented archery, he rode as well as he shot.
The Muses asked Zeus to honor him with a place in the sky.
Toward his bow lies the center of the Milky Way.
sagittarius.close: What you believed may ask to be tested again.

capricorn.title: Retrograde in Capricorn
capricorn.kicker: What each planet revisits when it turns back in Capricorn

rows.t: Long-term plans and formal commitments; revise the route before you climb.
Love you postponed for duty; make room for tenderness now.
Ambition that ran on discipline alone; climb at a sustainable pace.
Your definition of success; measure it by meaning, not status.
Your relationship with authority and rules; keep the structures that support you.
Traditions you follow by default; renew them, or build new ones.
The image of the ideal achiever; let ambition serve your real dreams.
Where control replaced responsibility; rebuild your authority on integrity.

capricorn.bridge: Capricorn climbs; retrograde checks every foothold.
story: The sea-goat is older than Greece: a Babylonian goat-fish.
In Mesopotamia it was linked to Ea, god of sweet waters.
In the Greek telling, Pan fled the monster Typhon.
He leapt into the river: his lower half became a fish.
Zeus set that clever escape among the stars.
capricorn.close: What you built may ask to be shaped again.

aquarius.title: Retrograde in Aquarius
aquarius.kicker: What each planet revisits when it turns back in Aquarius

rows.t: Ideas you shared with your circles; revisit them with a fresher mind.
Friendships and chosen family; notice which bonds still feel mutual.
Causes you fight for; make sure they still reflect your values.
Your hopes for the future; refresh the vision with present wisdom.
Your role in the community; contribute without losing your own voice.
The rebel within; ask whether you resist from freedom or habit.
Utopian dreams; turn shared ideals into gestures you can actually make.
Group pressure and collective power; stay true while you stay connected.

aquarius.bridge: Aquarius looks ahead; retrograde makes it look around.
story: In the Greek telling, he is Ganymede, a youth of Troy.
Zeus's eagle carried him up to Olympus.
There he became cupbearer to the gods.
In the sky he pours water from an urn toward the south.
The stream flows to the Southern Fish and bright Fomalhaut.
aquarius.close: What you envisioned may ask to be renewed.

pisces.title: Retrograde in Pisces
pisces.kicker: What each planet revisits when it turns back in Pisces

rows.t: Thoughts that drifted unspoken; give your intuitions clear, simple words.
Love that dissolved your boundaries; offer compassion and keep yourself.
Battles you avoided by retreating; act gently, but do act.
Your faith and your generosity; give without emptying yourself.
Your dreams without a shape; give them a simple, steady structure.
Your spiritual habits; let a sudden insight wake up your practice.
Illusions you swam in willingly; see clearly and still believe.
What you surrendered too soon; reclaim it, or release it fully.

pisces.bridge: Pisces dissolves; retrograde lets the waters clear.
story: In the Greek telling, Aphrodite and Eros fled Typhon.
They leapt into a river and took the shape of fish.
They tied themselves with a cord so as not to be parted.
In the sky the two fishes swim apart, joined by that cord.
The knot is marked by the star Alrescha, 'the cord'.
pisces.close: What you dreamed may ask to be seen clearly.
